title: Banks Act Circular C2/2014 — Interpretation of definition of default as outlined in regulation 67 of the Regulations relating to Banks
enablingLegislation: Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Interpretation of definition of default as outlined in regulation 67 of the Regulations relating to Banks.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This circular applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Interpretation of definition of default as outlined in regulation 67 of the Regulations relating to Banks.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Interpretation of definition of default as outlined in regulation 67 of the Regulations relating to Banks. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
